name: naijacloud-cli
description: Command-line interface for NaijaCloud hosting: authenticate, and manage projects, services, deployments, domains and environment variables. Also serves those operations to AI agents over MCP via `naijacloud mcp`.
author: Fawaz Adebayo <fawaz.adebayo.ajibola@gmail.com> (https://github.com/Pherwerz)

scripts.//binary: Standalone executable for Homebrew / apt / yum / Scoop / WinGet, built with `bun build --compile`. Defaults to the host platform; `binary:all` cross-compiles every target from any machine.
scripts.binary:all: npm run build && node scripts/build-binary.mjs --target all
scripts.//prepare: Runs on `npm install` and on `npm install -g .`, so a fresh clone gets a usable build/cli.js without a separate step.
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
